name: pvfs2
description: OrangeFS (formerly PVFS2) client library and headers used by Open MPI's PVFS2/OrangeFS MPI-IO component. Builds the user-space client only: no server, kernel module, FUSE or MPI dependency.

ssl.description: Link the OrangeFS client against OpenSSL (libssl/libcrypto) from vcpkg instead of probing the build host.
